title: Call a small routine
summary: Assembly: Call a small routine. Start with 3.
introduction: call saves a return address and jumps. ret returns to the instruction after call.
learningObjectives: Call a small routine with Assembly

blocks.text: On x86-64 Linux, save lesson.asm. Run nasm -f elf64 lesson.asm -o lesson.o, then ld lesson.o -o lesson. Run ./lesson, then printf 'exit code: %s\n' "$?" immediately.

blocks.title: Call a small routine
blocks.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rdi, 4
    call twice
    mov rax, 60
    syscall
twice:
    add rdi, rdi
    ret

blocks.text: call enters twice with 4. The routine doubles rdi and ret returns with 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A routine reached by call should return with ret, not fall into unrelated code.
